description: List of contracts and its settlement date for futures symbols. Retrieve list of relatively recent contracts along with their settlement dates for futures symbols → Returns {base_code: string, contracts: [{code: string, settlement_date: string}]}. Use a specific contract code (e.g., CME_MINI:NQH2024) with get_symbol_history for deep history.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

symbol.description: Symbol in Exchange:Symbol format (e.g., NASDAQ:AAPL, NYSE:TSLA). You can search for this symbol code using the /v3/symbols/search endpoint.

name: get_symbol_contracts
